room_rent.note: Base: any twin-sharing room (min 2 beds) without co-pay. Single Private / All Room Category opted via room-modification benefit; co-pay applies if higher than eligible category

icu.note: Any ICU ward always paid up to Sum Insured

copayment.note: No co-pay for twin-sharing in Rise-Tiered Network. Flat 20% co-pay if treatment outside network or higher room category opted; 'No Co-Pay Network' optional removes it

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible available as option (cannot combine with co-pay option)

ped_waiting.note: PED Waiting Time Modification: can reduce or increase PED waiting via option

specific_disease_waiting.note: Cancer covered after 30 days; accident from day 1

maternity.note: Maternity listed under Excl18. VERIFY optional maternity availability

cumulative_bonus.note: +10% of expiring Base SI each policy year, accumulates up to 100%

restoration.display: Once/yr full SI (Re-fill); unlimited via ReAssure Forever
restoration.note: Re-fill: once/year adds full Base SI for any illness (same or different). ReAssure Forever (unlimited restorations) available; baseline Re-fill kept

ambulance.note: Road ambulance up to ₹2,000 per hospitalization

grace_period.note: 30 days all modes; 15 days for monthly instalments

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity/IVF/OPD excluded (Excl18); India-only; 20% co-pay outside Rise-Tiered Network or higher room category

optional_riders.display: ReAssure Forever (unlimited SI), Room modification, PED waiting modification, No Co-Pay Network, Annual Aggregate Deductible, Personal Accident, Hospital Daily Cash, Return/Smart Cash
